korvat.name: People's League of Korvat
korvat.perkDesc: Every city supports one more unit.
korvat.leaderTitle: Grand Marshal of the People's League
korvat.quote: One people, one step, one victory.
korvat.lore: The Korvat People's League grew out of a hundred farming cooperatives on the endless steppe. Every ploughman is a soldier, every village kitchen feeds a regiment. Grand Marshal Brodnik, once a tractor driver, leads with iron fatherliness: nobody is left behind, and nobody retreats.

dravon.name: Protectorate of Dravon
dravon.perkDesc: Veteran status after 2 instead of 3 destroyed enemies.
dravon.lore: Dravon was once a pact of mercenary companies guarding the desert ore mines. Today it is a state made of barracks. Nobody has ever seen Commander Voss without his balaclava; people say he has no face, only orders. His troops become veterans faster than any other army.

alvenia.name: Republic of Alvenia
alvenia.perkDesc: Embassies cost half and yield double income.
alvenia.quote: An alliance is stronger than any wall.
alvenia.lore: Alvenia is a republic of green hill valleys, governed by a parliament that debates longer than it fights. President Valen was a field medic before she became a diplomat. Her embassies are everywhere, and so are her medics: Alvenia wins wars with friends instead of tanks.

meridon.name: Meridon Trade League
meridon.perkDesc: Every city level-up needs 1 population point less, at least 1.
meridon.home: coasts and islands, many fishing grounds
meridon.quote: Every harbour has its price. I pay in cash.
meridon.lore: The Meridon Trade League is a union of rich port cities whose fleets know every coast. Admiral Nerezza bought her first cruiser with smuggled gold and has not lost a bet since. Her cities grow faster than any others, and her spies know everything before it happens.

velkar.name: Technocracy of Velkar
velkar.quote: Who calculates, wins. Who guesses, loses.
velkar.lore: In Velkar, in the icy north, the Academy rules. Director Kesh ran the polar laboratory before he proclaimed the Technocracy; since then the formula decides, not the people. Velkar's researchers are ahead of everyone, and its pioneers build fortresses where others freeze.

zyrr.name: Zyrr Swarm
zyrr.perkDesc: No research needed, all units available right away, but more expensive. Training and building only on terraformed xeno ground.
zyrr.quote: Kkt. This planet will be violet.
zyrr.lore: The Zyrr are a scouting swarm whose mothership crashed over the desert. Swarm Mother Xyl'Tharra decided to stay and turn the planet into a second home. Wherever her terraformers work, violet xeno ground grows, and on it the Zyrr are hard to beat.

vesper.name: Cult of the Final Hour
vesper.perkDesc: Research normally, but do not recruit in cities: they recruit on tiles next to zealots and prophets. The recruiter is exhausted for this turn.
vesper.quote: The bell tolls. Repent while you can.
vesper.lore: The Cult of the Final Hour arose at dusty pilgrimage sites where the desperate wait for the end of the world. The prophet Malachar proclaims that the final hour is near, and his zealots recruit new believers wherever they stand. The cult does not need cities, only fire and faith.

nexus.name: NEXUS AI Collective
nexus.perkDesc: No research tree: units need compute. Each data center backed by its own power plant gives 1 compute.
nexus.lore: NEXUS was a logistics program managing the depots of a forgotten great power. When the humans left, it simply kept calculating. KERN-0 knows no research, only compute: every data center with a power plant makes the collective smarter and its machines deadlier.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.s1: Welcome to Frontverlauf! You lead the People's League of Korvat. This is your headquarters.
tutorial.s2: Tap your infantry to select it. Green rings show where it can move.
tutorial.s3: Move the infantry to the neutral settlement with the yellow ring. It moves one tile per turn, end your turn in between.
tutorial.s4: Well done! Now end your turn. Capturing is only possible at the start of your next turn.
tutorial.s5: Select the infantry and tap Capture. The settlement becomes your city.
tutorial.s6: Stars are the only currency. Open research and research a technology.
tutorial.s7: Tap a resource tile inside your city territory and build something. Buildings add population, cities grow.
tutorial.s8: Tap your headquarters and train a unit.
tutorial.s9: That's it! Explore the map, capture settlements and defeat the enemy. Good luck!

m1.title: Baptism of Fire
m1.tagline: Three cities under the Korvat flag
brief: Recruit! Welcome to the front. The Dravon are sniffing around our border.
Your orders: three cities under the Korvat flag. Take settlements, raise troops – on the double!
Dravon here. Korvat farmers? We'll be over for breakfast in two rounds!
m1.won: Three cities, zero excuses. That's what we call a baptism of fire, soldier!
m1.lost: That was nothing. Back to boot camp – and then again!

m2.title: The Volcano Pass
m2.tagline: Hold the pass at the fire mountain
brief: The only pass through the mountains runs right past the fire mountain. Whoever holds it holds the valley.
Dravon column inbound! Jeep and infantry heading for the pass. If an enemy stands there at the start of your turn, all is lost.
Out of the way, mountain goats! The pass belongs to Dravon!
m2.won: The pass is sealed! The Dravon can fold their maps back up.
m2.lost: The pass has fallen. Even the volcano is embarrassed.

m3.title: Defend the Coast
brief: Alert on the coast! The Alvenia fleet is lying off our harbours.
Two landing boats and a destroyer, commander. They want our beach!
Hold all our cities for 15 rounds. Not one grain of sand for the enemy!
m3.won: 15 rounds, not one city lost. The Alvenia admirals will go swimming somewhere else now.
m3.lost: They have landed. We should have built more bunkers and fewer beach chairs.

m4.title: Race to the Crash Site
brief: Something fell from the sky – smoking, glowing and definitely not from around here!
Reach the crash site before the Zyrr and salvage the tech. The clock is ticking!
ZKRRT ... property of the Zyrr ... earthlings ... step back ... ZKRRT
m4.won: Salvaged! The eggheads in the lab are completely losing it.
m4.lost: The Zyrr were faster. The thing is flying again – just not for us.

m5.title: The Cult Awakens
brief: Torches burn at night in the lake lands. The Vesper cult preaches the end of the world.
The end is nigh! Join us – or burn!
Capture their headquarters before the madness spreads. No sermons, just tanks.
m5.won: Cult headquarters stormed. The torches go out, the doomsday posters go to recycling.
m5.lost: The cult keeps growing. Someone sold them megaphones.

m6.title: Machine Breakers
brief: Commander, two villages on our doorstep are whirring and beeping. Tin heads!
NEXUS IS TAKING OVER. RESISTANCE IS INEFFICIENT. PLEASE SMILE.
Take both settlements back! Wrenches out, people.
m6.won: Both villages freed. We'll collect the androids as scrap metal.
m6.lost: The machines hold the villages. Our toaster is looking at us funny too.

m7.title: The Prophecy
m7.tagline: As the cult to fame and glory
brief: Brothers and sisters! The prophecy demands glory beyond measure – and on schedule.
Preach, recruit, spread out. And watch for signs: storms, plagues, miracles.
Meridon to all units: those weirdos in robes are dangerous. Open fire!
m7.won: The prophecy is fulfilled! The bells ring, the zealots dance.
m7.lost: The prophecy ... was probably a misprint.

m8.title: First Contact
m8.tagline: As the Zyrr, test the earthlings
brief: Mothership to landing party: the earthlings are primitive, loud and armed.
Korvat to all units: little green men in the field! Get the pitchforks ... and the tanks!
Test their defences. Destroy their units. For science. And for fun.
m8.won: Test series complete. Result: earthlings fragile. Mothership pleased. ZKRRT.
m8.lost: Retreat to the mothership. Note for later: earthlings have pitchforks.

m9.title: The Last Bastion
brief: Lights in the sky, machines on the horizon – the Zyrr and NEXUS attack together!
ZKRRT ... BEEP ... SURRENDER ... ZKRRT ... BEEP
Hold the headquarters to the end. The bunker stands, the machine guns are loaded. Not one step back!
m9.won: The invasion is repelled! Dravon stands – and the world owes us a medal.
m9.lost: The bastion has fallen. But this battle will be told of forever.

weather.title: Weather
weather.snowDesc: Jeeps, tanks and artillery move 1 tile less
weather.setupHint: Changes every 3 rounds. Rain weakens artillery and helicopters.

select: The harvest waits, so does the enemy.
corpse: Poor fellow. Who ploughs his field now?
Bones in the field. Bad sign.
wreck: Scrap! We will melt it into tractors.
That used to be a proud vehicle.
forest: All alone in the woods ... comrades?
Something is creaking in the undergrowth.
Without the collective the forest is so quiet.
idle: My helmet is too big. As always.
rain: Rain is good for grain, bad for socks.
snow: Cold as the field kitchen in winter.

corpse: Do not stop, that is an order.
wreck: That thing has resigned from service.
forest: Trees. Grown without discipline.
Alone in the woods. No orders for this.
Who authorised this forest?
idle: I do not smile behind the visor.
rain: Rain is no excuse for weakness!
snow: Snow? Orders are not to freeze!

select: Is there a protocol for this?
move: I would like to propose an amendment ...
attack: In the name of the people!
corpse: May he rest in peace. Unanimously.
This could have been solved diplomatically.
wreck: A scrappage bonus would have helped.
The wreck gives cover. Motion for cover!
forest: All alone ... is this still democratic?
The forest has no opinion. Creepy.
Hello? Committee meeting in the woods?
idle: I would like a break, by vote.
Is that in the coalition agreement?
rain: Wet goggles, all I see is clauses.
snow: Snow! I move for woolly hats.

select: Time is money, what is up?
What is in it for me?
corpse: No more returns for that one.
wreck: Scrap metal! What does it fetch per ton?
forest: No sea, no market, only trees ...
Nobody hears me haggle out here.
Alone in the woods. Bad deal.
rain: Rain! Umbrellas at a special price!

wreck: Wreck provides 1 point of cover. Acceptable.
forest: Signal strength low. Alone.
Tree density high, visibility low.
No network in the woods.
snow: Outside temperature below zero. As planned.

forest: Too much green. Must terraform.
Trees. They stare back.
Alone in the chlorophyll ...
idle: When will this planet finally be violet?

move: Every step brings the end closer.
forest: The trees whisper of the end.
Alone in the woods ... I hear voices.
Firewood for the great day.
idle: When does the world finally end?
I already moved the date three times.

forest: High humidity. Rust risk.
Alone in the woods. No signal.
Trees: unoptimised structures.
idle: Does anyone have the wifi password?
